title: A finite admissible coordinate cover over the original base
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], and let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. There exist finitely many affine opens $U_a\subset X$, affine opens $V_a\subset Y$, and etale maps $e_a^0:U_a\to\mathbf A^d_{V_a}$ over $V_a$, with $f(U_a)\subset V_a$, whose inclusions $j_a:U_a\hookrightarrow X$ cover $X$. Here affine space and etale maps have the meanings of [def-sbc-affine-space, def-weil-etale-morphism]. The composite $e_a:U_a\to\mathbf A^d_{V_a}\hookrightarrow\mathbf A^d_Y$ is separated etale of finite presentation, and $fj_a=p_de_a$. Each $j_a$ is a quasi-compact open immersion of finite type [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. The schemes $U_a,V_a,\mathbf A^d_{V_a},\mathbf A^d_Y$ are Noetherian (they admit finite affine covers by spectra of rings with ascending chain condition on ideals), separated and finite type over $k$; in particular all chart maps meet the geometric hypotheses of finite-ring compact-support and sum-extension adjunctions. The empty cover is allowed for $X=\varnothing$.

source.place: Tag 054L, lemma-smooth-etale-over-affine-space; finite-cover and separated finite-presentation admissibility elaborated in retained Step 13 of the exceptional-comparison proof

proof.text: The field k is Noetherian. Apply lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian through Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace to the structure maps. Assemble IsNoetherian X and IsNoetherian Y. Their underlying spaces are Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 01T6, lemma-finite-type-noetherian; Schemes Tags 01K4, 01KN, 01KU (qcqs over an affine base)

proof.text: Reuse the proved adopted-source theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.exists_etale_to_affineSpace, in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Smooth. Its proof applies lem-sc-standard-smooth-local-relative-dimension and lem-sc-standard-smooth-etale-polynomial-chart, identifies the polynomial spectrum with affine space by def-sbc-affine-space, and uses isoSpec naturality to obtain the factorization as f.resLE. This theorem preserves the specified dimension d and supplies affine U_x and V_x, x in U_x, hUV, and the etale e0_x with its projection identity. The more general variable-dimension normal form is not used.

source.place: Tag 054L, lemma-smooth-etale-over-affine-space, proof (last d variables); Tags 01V7 and 02G1 for the prescribed relative dimension; Schemes Tag 01I1 for the affine square

proof.text: Choose the pointwise charts, then use isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover on the open sets U_x. Reindex the resulting Finset s by Fin s.card using s.equivFin.symm, carrying the base opens and maps along the same index function. The coverage proof transports the finite-subcover membership along this equivalence. An empty source has no indexing points, so its finite subcover has cardinal zero.

Each chosen U_a and V_a is affine, hence compact and separated, and is locally Noetherian as an open subscheme of X or Y by lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian. Assemble their IsNoetherian instances. Their inclusions are open immersions, locally of finite type, and quasi-compact by Mathlib quasiCompact_of_noetherianSpace_source. Compose with the original separated finite-type structure morphisms using the composition instances to obtain every requested property over k.

source.place: Tags 01OW, 01OZ (open subschemes of Noetherian schemes); Schemes Tags 03GI, 01L7, 01KU; Morphisms Tags 01T2, 01T3

proof.text: AffineSpace projections are affine and locally of finite presentation for the finite coordinate type ULift (Fin d), by the instances in Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineSpace. They are therefore separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type. For the affine space over Y, explicitly transport local Noetherianity and compactness along its projection and assemble IsNoetherian; for that over each V_a do the same, with compactness also available from affineness. Composition instances give separation, local finite type and quasi-compactness of their maps to Spec k.

The flipped square AffineSpace.isPullback_map for V_a.ι makes AffineSpace.map of V_a.ι an open immersion by stability under base change. Define e_a as its composite with e0_a. It is etale by composition. Rewrite with AffineSpace.map_over, the projection identity for e0_a and Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι to prove U_a.ι composed with f equals e_a composed with the affine-space projection.

source.place: Tags 02GP (lemma-open-immersion-etale), 02GN (lemma-composition-etale); restriction of affine space to an open of its base

proof.text: Each e_a is locally of finite presentation because it is etale. Its source is affine and thus absolutely separated; the Mathlib separated-source instance, proved by cancellation, makes e_a separated, hence quasi-separated. Its source is Noetherian, so quasiCompact_of_noetherianSpace_source makes it quasi-compact. These instances give all remaining conjuncts. No coordinate is selected by the argument, so the construction also handles d=0 and empty X or Y.
